When discussing human nature, Confucian philosophers, for example, referred to people without exception.

title: Incompatibilist (Nondeterministic) Theories of Free Will
takeaways: Incompatibilists hold that free will and determinism are mutually exclusive and, consequently, that we act freely (i.e., with free will) only if determinism is false.

One question that divides them concerns which type of indeterminism - uncaused events, nondeterministically caused events, or agent caused events - is required.
